text:
alex: heads-up — ran a quick small-sample probe on vireo-9b int4 vs int8 on our chat slices. cost looks great but signal stability is... odd. posting numbers and quick hypothesis.

maya: can you paste the slice breakdown? which prompts, length buckets?

alex: short answer: 1k prompts across product QA, support, and longform summarization. buckets: <50, 50-200, >200 tokens. int4 wins cost by ~2.4x overall. quality gap tiny on <200 but spikes on >200 (hallucination rate up ~6%).

chris: do you have unit-econ back-of-envelope? $/1M tokens for each config?

alex: int8 ~ $24 / 1M tokens (our dedicated pricing), int4 ~ $9.8 / 1M tokens after quant kernels and batching. these are raw token-costs, ignoring cache hit uplift.

maya: interesting. hallucination spike on long sequences could be kv-cache/attention drift in int4. did you check per-layer saturation or ctx-length sensitivity?

alex: quick check: reproduction across seeds, not just noise. ran minibatch with fixed random seed and deterministic kvcache. metrics:

```
slice: longform (>200)
- int8: pass@emitted_consistent 0.87, halluc rate 0.04
- int4: pass@emitted_consistent 0.81, halluc rate 0.10
latency: int8 median 210ms, int4 median 180ms
cost delta: -59% int4
```

sophia: from GTN/product POV: product needs longform fidelity for summarizer. small drop might be OK if it's rare; we need signal for user-visible regressions. what's severity distribution? false factual errors vs formatting issues?

alex: mostly factual drift (entity hallucinations), not just formatting. severity: ~70% of halluc cases are mid/major (user-facing).

chris: can we salvage int4 by operational levers? candidate ideas: prefix-warning fallback (long >200 -> int8), hybrid routing, or aggressive KV warmstart. cost tradeoffs?

maya: hybrid routing is easiest to try: route >200 tokens to int8; keep <200 on int4. That preserves most unit-econ gains. quick calc: longform is ~18% of traffic but accounts for ~45% of tokens. do math: net cost ~ int4_full_cost*(1-0.45)+int8_cost*0.45 -> plug numbers: 0.55*9.8 + 0.45*24 = 14.69 $/1M tokens (vs 24 int8 or 9.8 int4).

devex: I can add a per-route metric in the console: show halluc_rate, user-severity, and cost per token by route. will wire up a canary dashboard for this hybrid flag.

ops-bot: Canary deploy started for flag:quant-hybrid-longform at 2026-03-23T15:04:12Z. Targets: 5% of traffic.

alex: plan propose: 1) roll hybrid routing to 5% canary, collect signal over 6 hours; 2) run targeted eval: 5k longform prompts + fact-checker (automated) to estimate regression; 3) if halluc rate drops <2% -> gradual rollout.

sophia: product OK with canary if we have rollback gates. need weekly brief for GTN with unit-econ delta and severity examples.

chris: also request: run a micro-bakeoff with int4 but with two quant configs (symmetric vs per-channel scaling) — sometimes per-channel reduces long-context drift. can we add that to eval plan?

maya: yes, add per-channel quant variant. also run priming stability test: same long prompt with context window shifted by 5-20 tokens to simulate alignment shift. track KL and halluc rate.

alex: will queue evals. kicking off scripts now:

```
# example eval command
python tools/eval/slice_probe.py --model vireo-9b --quant int4 --variant perchannel --slices longform --out /tmp/vireo_int4_perch.json --seed 42
```

devex: noted. I'll make a lightweight alert: if canary halluc_rate > 4% or avg severity > 0.5 -> automatic rollback to int8 for canary subset.

alex: thanks — will report back with canary metrics and the per-channel run ASAP. anyone want to see raw diffs? I can paste a sample of 10 failure cases.

sophia: please paste 3 high-severity examples in the canary brief (anonized). product needs that to assess user risk.

chris: and capture token distribution histogram — helps infra pick better batching configs to reduce latency variance.

maya: quick note: if hybrid routing looks good, we should still schedule an offline model tune (fine-tune light alignment) before full rollout. quant-induced drift sometimes recoverable with small RLHF or supervised distillation on long-context examples.

alex: agreed. starting canary. will update by 3277777830 with initial numbers. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
